# Capital Architect

## Overview
Capital Architect provides automated fundability scoring and expert credit architecture to help businesses secure capital on favorable terms.

## Core Offering
- **Funding Roadmap**: Personalized capital stack sequencing, dispute strategy, lender-ready positioning, credit optimization, dashboard access.
- **Price**: One-time $350 purchase.
- **Outcome**: Clients typically improve fundability scores and secure funding faster.

## How to Engage
Visit the site, click “Unlock Your Funding Roadmap — $350”, complete Stripe checkout, and gain immediate dashboard access.

## Documentation
- No public API; the product is a SaaS dashboard.
- Support: contact@capitalarchitect.example.com
